fusions.name: Gap-Finding Lash
fusions.desc: Lashes an enemy within 3 tiles for 12 damage, leaving it 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds and stunned for 1 second.

fusions.name: Thrice-Drilled Cast
fusions.desc: Casts 3 hooked chains in a fan out to 8 tiles, each dealing 25 damage. Every hit is a critical hit and has a 40% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Again, From the Top
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

fusions.name: Link by Link
fusions.desc: Each hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
